name: Microgrid generator excitation reference interface
aliases: microgrids Microgrid voltage and reactive-power controls
summary: Transfers the assigned voltage or reactive-control demand to the generator excitation-control interface.
description: Transfers the assigned voltage or reactive-control demand to the generator excitation-control interface. Voltage and reactive-power control coordinate the AC operating condition of the microgrid resources. A voltage target, reactive-power target and power-factor target represent different control objectives and should have explicit ownership.

In an islanded microgrid, the assigned reference source supports bus voltage while other compatible resources share reactive demand according to the selected control method. Grid-connected operation can use a different objective at the PCC. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Authorized excitation demand” at the input and “Generator regulator reference” at the output. The generator regulator defines the accepted interface.
